criteria.requirement: Implement alive_progress.weighted.alive_weighted_it(source,weight,*,total=None,finalize=None,**bar_options). Use real alive_bar and snapshots; evaluate weight exactly once per consumed item before yielding, require nonnegative nonboolean integer (zero allowed), and acknowledge that weight only when iteration resumes. Keep item identity/order and explicit total-work units, without inspecting or summing the whole source. Falsey weight/finalizer callables work; only normal exhaustion finalizes once, not early close or source/weight failure. Reject manual mode and preserve original alive_it.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
